name: Amulet of Spell Mastery
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 256
Aura strong transmutation; CL 11th
Slot neck; Price 22,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This platinum locket only has power when used as a wizard’s bonded object. It allows the wizard to prepare an additional 6 levels of spells per day.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Items, mnemonic enhancer; Cost 11,000 gp
